en.headline: Cyclothon closures begin at Mody Road from noon
en.dek: The Transport Department says a loading area and a slow lane off Mody Road close from Saturday noon, with wider closures from 1am on Sunday.
body: The Transport Department has set out special traffic arrangements for the Hong Kong Cyclothon on Sunday, with the first closures beginning at noon on Saturday.

From noon on Saturday until about 6pm on Sunday, the loading and unloading area outside Mody Road Garden, and the slow lane of Mody Road westbound outside that area, will be closed. Wider closures start at 1am on Sunday and run in stages through the morning and early afternoon.

Among the roads listed are the upper deck of the Lantau Link towards Kowloon, from 1am to about 7:15am; Ting Kau Bridge, the Cheung Tsing Tunnel, Nam Wan Tunnel and Stonecutters Bridge on routes out of Kowloon, from 1am to about 12:30pm; and sections of Museum Drive, Cultural Drive, Austin Road West, Jordan Road and the Central Kowloon Bypass around West Kowloon.

The department said traffic towards Kowloon on the Lantau Link and Tsuen Wan Road, and around Jordan Road, Ferry Street, Lin Cheung Road and the Kai Tak Tunnel, is expected to be markedly heavier than on a normal Sunday. It advised the public and visitors to watch for temporary closures and changes to public transport. Illegally parked vehicles in the closed areas may be towed.

zh.headline: 單車節封路周六中午由麼地道開始
zh.dek: 運輸署公布周日香港單車節特別交通安排，麼地道上落客貨區及慢線周六中午起封閉，主要封路則由周日凌晨1時展開。
body: 運輸署已公布周日香港單車節的特別交通安排，首批封路周六中午開始。
由周六中午至周日下午約6時，麼地道花園對出的上落客貨區，以及該處麼地道西行慢線會封閉。較大範圍封路由周日凌晨1時起分階段實施，涵蓋上午至下午初段。
署方列出的路段包括：往九龍方向的青嶼幹線上層，凌晨1時至約上午7時15分；汀九橋、長青隧道、南灣隧道及昂船洲大橋等出九龍路線，凌晨1時至約下午12時30分；以及西九一帶的博物館道、文化道、柯士甸道西、佐敦道及中九龍繞道部分路段。
運輸署預計，青嶼幹線及荃灣路往九龍方向，以及佐敦道、渡船街、連翔道及啟德隧道一帶，交通會較平常周日明顯擠塞。署方呼籲市民及旅客留意臨時封路及公共交通改動。封路範圍內違例停泊的車輛，可能被拖走。
